thread:
sasha: Heads-up: we're running a staging canary pen-test simulation next Wed 09:30 PT. Goal: validate RBAC gating, KMS-grant-only access, and sanitized audit slices. Need ops lead + uploader. No full DB dumps.
leo: I can take ops lead for the sim. Ops will produce a 1h rolling sample and a focused 24h slice for any flagged auth endpoints. We'll run sanitization before handoff.
arun: For KMS, let's avoid granting broad kms:Decrypt. Plan: create a time-limited Grant scoped by EncryptionContextSubset and restrict Decrypt to a single ciphertext or purpose tag. That way the assessor cannot decrypt arbitrary objects.
sasha: Agreed. Can we produce a manifest template so the assessor can verify integrity?
tess: Manifest idea (small): object, sha256, kms_key_arn, presign_ttl, grant_arn, uploader, signature. Example manifest line: {"object":"svc-auth-2026-04-01.tar.gz","sha256":"<hash>","kms":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:alias/staging-logs","ttl":3600,"uploader":"leo","grant":"arn:aws:kms:...","sig":"<kms-signed-b64>"}
arun: Example grant command (use EncryptionContextSubset and revoke after window):
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id alias/staging-logs \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-test-auditor \
  --operations Decrypt \
  --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"pt-canary"}
```
This grant can be programmatically revoked after the session.
sasha: Perfect. Leo — can you run the upload and post presign + grant ARN here? Also ensure the manifest is KMS-signed or GPG-signed.
leo: Will do tonight. Upload script will: 1) sanitize logs, 2) create tar, 3) call kms create-grant helper, 4) upload to s3, 5) write manifest and sign. Quick script preview: `./tools/pt_push.sh svc-auth-2026-04-01.tar.gz --ttl 3600`
sasha: Ops checklist items: sanitization sign-off by security, manifest sha256, grant ARN, presign URL TTL, assessor contact, no PII in slices. Also record S3 access logs and KMS CloudTrail events for the window.
tess: I'll own the sanitization checklist. Steps: redact emails, hash user IDs, obfuscate IPs to /24, remove full query strings, strip secrets, and provide a sanitized sample for security review before release.
arun: KMS-bot: can we get an automated revoke scheduled in the workflow after TTL?
kms-bot: Automation note: recommend creating Grant and scheduling revoke via lambda or orchestration. Example revoke scheduling payload supported. Also emit Grant ARN in manifest for traceability.
leo: Upload complete — presign: https://staging.s3.amazonaws.com/pt/svc-auth-2026-04-01.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=3600 ; manifest: https://staging.s3.amazonaws.com/pt/svc-auth-2026-04-01-manifest.json ; Grant ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:grant/7c8d9e0f1a2b ; TTL: 3600s. I'll tail access logs during the sim.
sasha: Thanks. Retest cadence: prefer 10 business day retest window after remediation. If remediation changes privileges or increases scope, pause deploys for impacted service and escalate to #incidents.
tess: Ack. I'll run the sanitization review at 09:00 PT on sim day and sign the manifest if OK.
arun: I'll instrument CloudTrail and log an access snapshot post-run (KMS Decrypt events + S3 GetObject events) for the assessor report.
kms-bot: Scheduled action: revoke grant arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:grant/7c8d9e0f1a2b at 2026-04-01T17:00:00Z (automated).
sasha: Quick action list: leo — uploader + presign (done); tess — sanitization & sign; arun — CloudTrail snapshot; sasha — assessor coordination + retest scheduling. React with :white_check_mark: once you ack.
leo: :white_check_mark: monitoring access logs.
tess: :white_check_mark: will sign if sanitization passes.
arun: :white_check_mark: will collect CloudTrail snippet.
sasha: Thanks, team. We'll run a 30min post-mortem in #eng-security the day after to capture lessons and update the playbook.
